mechanism: Both agents are broad-spectrum antibiotics with overlapping coverage; concurrent use increases risk of photosensitivity (minocycline) and potential for additive GI effects, though they have different mechanisms of action (macrolide vs tetracycline).
action: Concurrent use is generally acceptable but avoid if possible; if necessary, counsel on photosensitivity precautions, monitor for GI upset, and ensure appropriate dosing intervals.
